name: Crying Game
original_name: クライング ゲーム
source:
Shin majors in piano at a music college. One day he gets acquainted with student who calls himself Sugi. Sugi disappears the next night. And TV news seem to have a clue about this sudden vanishing.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
真在音乐学院主修钢琴。一天，他结识了一名自称杉的学生。第二天晚上，杉失踪了。而电视新闻似乎提供了与这起突然失踪有关的线索。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
